data.one_liner: Provides Apple SF Symbol icons as Flutter Icon widgets via a bundled font.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles the SF Symbols font and exposes each symbol as a constant in the SFSymbols class. Developers can use these constants with the standard Icon widget to display system‑provided symbols on iOS and Android.
use_when: You need Apple SF Symbol icons in a Flutter app
You want a simple, null‑safe way to reference system icons without creating custom assets
avoid_when: You require icons not covered by SF Symbols
Your app’s branding conflicts with Apple’s SF Symbol licensing restrictions
strengths: Easy to use with standard Icon widget
Null‑safe and requires only pubspec configuration
Works on both iOS and Android
weaknesses: Limited to the set of Apple SF Symbols
Potential licensing constraints for commercial use
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_sfsymbols to pubspec dependencies and include the sficonsets font asset in the fonts section of pubspec.yaml
